Our Mission

Passing on the gift of Indian classical music

We are a volunteer-led community offering a stage for emerging and established artists, connecting students with gurus, and creating a welcoming space for rasikas to explore the nuances of Hindustani and Carnatic traditions.

  • Monthly community baithaks featuring vocal, instrumental, and dance showcases
  • Workshops, lecture demonstrations, and riyaz circles for seekers of all ages
  • Scholarships and instrument funds powered by community donations
